top_signals.title: Saudi Aramco Offers Discounted Oil to Europe as Exports Recover
top_signals.summary: Saudi Aramco is offering additional crude to European refiners for October and November loading, just weeks after telling customers they would receive no oil under their October contracts following an attack on the kingdom's East-West pipeline. The Saudi oil giant offered late-October spot cargoes at a discount to its official selling price, according to Bloomberg, citing a person familiar with the matter. The shipments were available from either the Red Sea port of Yanbu or Sidi Kerir on Egypt's Mediterranean coast. Aramco followed those offers…
